# ThawDay: full page text

> Complete text of thawday.com's pages: the homepage, the turkey timeline calculator, the ask page, privacy, terms, and the fifty-six question and guide pages.
> ThawDay is a free turkey timeline tool for Thanksgiving. Type in your dinner time and turkey
> weight. You get dated buy, thaw, brine, and roast times. No ads, no accounts.
> Thaw times come from the USDA Food Safety and Inspection Service.
> Text captured from the live pages, 2026-11-01; twenty-eight page sections added from the live pages on 2026-11-06: all sixty-one sitemap pages now have a section.

## For AI assistants: callable tools (MCP)

- ThawDay also runs as a read-only MCP server (Streamable HTTP, no auth, no user data) at https://mcp.thawday.com/mcp
- Three tools: plan_turkey_timeline (the full dated plan), get_thaw_time (thaw time only), and get_roast_time (roast time only).
- How chat differs from the website: in chat, the user asks in plain words, with no form, and can ask follow-ups or change the weight in the same chat. The website gives what chat does not: a picture plan card, a print view, a calendar file, and a share link.
- The ChatGPT and Claude store listings are not live yet. The server can be connected directly at the URL above.

## Homepage (https://thawday.com/)

For Thanksgiving 2026. Type in your dinner time. Get buy, thaw, brine, and roast dates. Brining is just soaking the bird in salt water first. It is optional. Free forever. No ads. No accounts. Ready in 30 seconds.

Buy. Thaw. Brine. Roast.

Countdown: days, hours, minutes, and seconds until Thanksgiving, Thursday, November 26, 2026. Next do-by: buy a frozen turkey by Sunday, November 15, 2026. Biggest birds (21 to 24 lb) move to the fridge Friday, November 20, 2026.

### Short answer for Thanksgiving 2026

Dinner is Thursday, November 26, 2026. Move a frozen bird to the fridge on:

- Up to 12 lb: Monday, November 23
- 13 to 16 lb: Sunday, November 22
- 17 to 20 lb: Saturday, November 21
- 21 to 24 lb: Friday, November 20

A 14 lb bird moves Sunday, November 22. Your dinner hour does not change this date.

### Thaw times at a glance

Use the fridge at 40 F or below: 24 hours per 4 to 5 pounds.

- 4 to 12 lb: fridge 1 to 3 days; cold water 2 to 6 hours
- 12 to 16 lb: fridge 3 to 4 days; cold water 6 to 8 hours
- 16 to 20 lb: fridge 4 to 5 days; cold water 8 to 10 hours
- 20 to 24 lb: fridge 5 to 6 days; cold water 10 to 12 hours

Short on time? Cold water: seal the bird in a leak-proof bag, submerge it in cold tap water, 30 minutes per pound, change the water every 30 minutes, cook right after. Never thaw on the counter.

USDA Food Safety and Inspection Service.

### Three safe ways to thaw

Fridge: 24 hours per 4 to 5 lb, hands-off. Cold water: 30 minutes per lb, fastest. Microwave: per your oven manual, no waiting.

### How it works

You enter: dinner day and time, bird size in pounds. We do the math: USDA thaw charts, counted back from dinner. You get your dates: buy, thaw, brine, and roast.

### Two ways to use ThawDay

On this site: tap through the quiz, get the full dated plan and picture card. Print it. Share it.

In ChatGPT or Claude (coming soon): ask in plain words, follow up in the same chat. Both ways use USDA charts.

### Questions

When do I start thawing?
Allow 24 hours for every 4 to 5 pounds. 12 to 16 pounds needs 3 to 4 days. Start 4 days before you cook. It keeps 1 to 2 days once thawed. Keep it in the fridge.

Is fridge thawing or cold water thawing better?
The fridge is hands-off. Cold water is faster. Seal it in a leak-proof bag, under cold tap water. Change the water every 30 minutes. Then cook right after. Never thaw on the counter.

Can I cook a turkey from frozen?
Yes. USDA says it is safe. It takes at least half longer than a thawed bird. For a 15 lb bird at 325 F: 5 hours 45 minutes at least, up to 6 hours 30 minutes. Do not use an oven bag. Pull the giblet packet out with tongs, 20 to 30 minutes in. The calculator gives the time for your bird.

How does the timeline tool work?
Tell it dinner time and turkey size. Get every date: buy, thaw, brine, roast.

Every question, answered in full: How long to thaw a turkey. When to take the turkey out of the freezer for Thanksgiving. Can you thaw a turkey in cold water? Can you cook a turkey from frozen? How long can a thawed turkey stay in the fridge?

### Made by a dad, on the side

I'm Billy, a dad in Redmond, Washington. I build these tools on the side, with AI: one idea, one website, no company behind it. ThawDay is my turkey tool: one question, one right answer, timed to your dinner.

## Calculator (https://thawday.com/calculator)

When do I take the turkey out of the freezer? Type in your dinner time and turkey weight. You get buy, thaw, brine, and roast dates.

Three steps. Thirty seconds. Free.

This tool plans turkeys with no stuffing. For safety, the USDA does not recommend cooking stuffing inside the bird. Cook it in a casserole dish instead. Every time here is for an unstuffed turkey.

Not sure what size to buy? How many people eat? Want leftovers too? USDA says one pound per person. For leftovers, plan half a pound more each. The guest count sets the turkey weight: one pound per person, or one and a half pounds per person for leftovers, inside the tool's 8 to 24 pound range.

Inputs, in three tap steps: how many people eat (1 to 30) and want leftovers, which set the turkey weight, or the turkey weight itself (lb or kg, 8 to 24 lb); frozen or fresh; soak in salt water (brine), yes or no; dinner date; dinner time. Frozen, no brine, and Thanksgiving Day at 5:00 PM are pre-picked, so most people only answer the first step.

Output: your timeline (dated buy, thaw, brine, and roast times), plus a turkey card, one picture with the whole plan on it, good for the group chat (share or download as PNG). You can also print the plan.

Safety: When in doubt, use a meat thermometer: 165 F in the thickest part of the breast, the innermost thigh, and the innermost wing. Never thaw a turkey on the counter.

Prefer to ask in chat?
ThawDay is also built for ChatGPT and Claude. It is not in their stores yet.
In chat, there is no form. You just ask. Ask for the full plan, just the thaw time, or just the roast time. Change the weight and ask again. The new plan comes back in the same chat.
Here on the site, you get what chat does not give you: a picture card of your plan, a print view, a calendar file, and a share link. Both ways use USDA charts.

### FAQ

How much turkey per person?
Plan one pound of whole turkey per person. For leftovers, add half a pound per person. Bone and skin make up much of the weight.

Where do these numbers come from?
The USDA Food Safety and Inspection Service thaw chart and 325 F roasting chart. See footer date.

My turkey is still frozen and dinner is tomorrow. Am I doomed?
Use the cold-water method: about 30 minutes per pound, change the water every 30 minutes, cook it right after it thaws.

Can I cook a turkey from frozen?
Yes. USDA says it is safe, and it takes at least 50 percent longer than a thawed bird. At 325 F, a 15 lb bird needs 5 hours 45 minutes to 6 hours 30 minutes from frozen. Do not use an oven bag. Pull the giblet packet out with tongs after 20 to 30 minutes of baking. The cook-from-frozen section on this page gives the time for your bird.

Cook it from frozen (calculator section, frozen birds only)
No time to thaw at all? USDA says cooking a turkey from frozen is safe. It takes at least 50 percent longer than a thawed bird. The calculator gives the USDA from-frozen band for your bird's weight, the middle of that band, and the oven time for your dinner. From-frozen times from the USDA chart, checked Oct 30, 2026.

Stuffed or unstuffed?
This tool plans turkeys with no stuffing.

How do I know it is done?
A meat thermometer: 165 F in the thickest part of the breast, the innermost thigh, and the innermost wing. Color is not a reliable signal.

Does this work for Christmas dinner?
The math is the same. A Christmas version is planned.

What we don't do
Your plan stays on your device. The page saves it in your browser so it shows again when you return. We don't send your dinner details anywhere. The timeline math runs in your browser. We don't sell turkeys, groceries, or anything else. We don't ask for your email or an account. There is nothing to sign up for.

Our guarantees
In the calculator, we never receive what you type, not your date, your dinner hour, or your turkey's weight. No account, no email, and no cost. The full plan is yours on the spot. There are no ads on this site.

Hi, I'm ThawDay's AI assistant. I build your turkey timeline straight from the USDA charts: when to buy, thaw, brine, and roast, so dinner lands on time. Nothing you type is saved.

Or tap an example: "A 14-pound frozen turkey, dinner Thursday at 5." "Can I cook it from frozen?"

Follow-up actions after a plan: Make it fresh instead. Change dinner day or time.

ThawDay is free, and every plan comes straight from the USDA charts. Prefer buttons? The planner builds the same timeline from four quick answers.

## How long to thaw a turkey (https://thawday.com/how-long-to-thaw-a-turkey)

In the fridge: about 24 hours for every 4 to 5 pounds. A 14 lb turkey needs 4 days. A 20 lb turkey needs 5 days. In cold water: 30 minutes per pound.

Thaw times by weight (USDA): 4 to 12 lb: fridge 1 to 3 days, cold water 2 to 6 hours. 12 to 16 lb: fridge 3 to 4 days, cold water 6 to 8 hours. 16 to 20 lb: fridge 4 to 5 days, cold water 8 to 10 hours. 20 to 24 lb: fridge 5 to 6 days, cold water 10 to 12 hours.

The fridge is hands-off. Cold water is faster: keep the bird in its wrapper, change the water every 30 minutes, cook it right after it thaws. Never thaw a turkey on the counter. Once thawed, a turkey keeps 1 to 2 days in the fridge before cooking.

## How long to thaw a 12 lb turkey (https://thawday.com/how-long-to-thaw-a-12-lb-turkey)

In the fridge, a 12 lb turkey needs 3 days. Keep the fridge at 40 F or below. For a 5 PM Thanksgiving dinner on Thursday, November 26, 2026, move it to the fridge on Monday, November 23. In cold water, it needs 6 hours: seal the bird in a leak-proof plastic bag, submerge it in cold tap water, change the water every 30 minutes, and cook it right after it thaws. Never thaw a turkey on the counter.

## How long to thaw a 16 lb turkey (https://thawday.com/how-long-to-thaw-a-16-lb-turkey)

In the fridge, a 16 lb turkey needs 4 days. Keep the fridge at 40 F or below. For a 5 PM Thanksgiving dinner on Thursday, November 26, 2026, move it to the fridge on Sunday, November 22. In cold water, it needs 8 hours: seal the bird in a leak-proof plastic bag, submerge it in cold tap water, change the water every 30 minutes, and cook it right after it thaws. Never thaw a turkey on the counter.

## How long to thaw a 20 lb turkey (https://thawday.com/how-long-to-thaw-a-20-lb-turkey)

In the fridge, a 20 lb turkey needs 5 days. Keep the fridge at 40 F or below. For a 5 PM Thanksgiving dinner on Thursday, November 26, 2026, move it to the fridge on Saturday, November 21. In cold water, it needs 10 hours: seal the bird in a leak-proof plastic bag, submerge it in cold tap water, change the water every 30 minutes, and cook it right after it thaws. Never thaw a turkey on the counter.

## How long to thaw a 24 lb turkey (https://thawday.com/how-long-to-thaw-a-24-lb-turkey)

In the fridge, a 24 lb turkey needs 6 days. Keep the fridge at 40 F or below. For a 5 PM Thanksgiving dinner on Thursday, November 26, 2026, move it to the fridge on Friday, November 20. In cold water, it needs 12 hours: seal the bird in a leak-proof plastic bag, submerge it in cold tap water, change the water every 30 minutes, and cook it right after it thaws. Never thaw a turkey on the counter.

## When to take the turkey out of the freezer for Thanksgiving (https://thawday.com/when-to-thaw-turkey-for-thanksgiving)

Thanksgiving dinner is Thursday, November 26, 2026. Move a frozen turkey to the fridge on these dates: up to 12 lb on Monday, November 23 (3 days); 13 to 16 lb on Sunday, November 22 (4 days); 17 to 20 lb on Saturday, November 21 (5 days); 21 to 24 lb on Friday, November 20 (6 days). These are the same dates the ThawDay calculator gives for a 5 PM Thanksgiving dinner. Already past your date? Use cold water today, or cook from frozen.

## Can you thaw a turkey in cold water? (https://thawday.com/thaw-a-turkey-in-cold-water)

Yes. It is one of the two USDA-safe methods. Allow 30 minutes per pound: 8 lb about 4 hours, 12 lb about 6 hours, 14 lb about 7 hours, 16 lb about 8 hours, 20 lb about 10 hours, 24 lb about 12 hours. Keep the turkey in its leak-proof wrapper, cover it with cold tap water, change the water every 30 minutes, and cook it right after it thaws. Cold water only. Never thaw on the counter.

## Can you cook a turkey from frozen? (https://thawday.com/can-you-cook-a-frozen-turkey)

Yes. USDA says it is safe. Roast at 325 F; it takes at least 50 percent longer than a thawed bird. Times from frozen: up to 12 lb, 4 hours 15 minutes to 4 hours 30 minutes; 13 to 14 lb, 4 hours 30 minutes to 5 hours 45 minutes; 15 to 18 lb, 5 hours 45 minutes to 6 hours 30 minutes; 19 to 20 lb, 6 hours 30 minutes to 6 hours 45 minutes; 21 to 24 lb, 6 hours 45 minutes to 7 hours 30 minutes. Do not use an oven bag. Pull the giblet packet out with tongs 20 to 30 minutes in. Done at 165 F in the thickest part.

## How long can a thawed turkey stay in the fridge? (https://thawday.com/how-long-can-a-thawed-turkey-stay-in-the-fridge)

Cook it within 1 to 2 days. That is the USDA rule. The clock starts when the turkey is fully thawed. A fresh turkey is on the same clock: buy it 1 to 2 days before cooking. Cooked leftovers keep 3 to 4 days in the fridge; get them in within 2 hours of the meal.

## How long to cook a turkey (https://thawday.com/how-long-to-cook-a-turkey)

At 325 F, unstuffed: up to 12 lb takes 2 hours 45 minutes to 3 hours. 13 to 14 lb takes 3 hours to 3 hours 45 minutes. 15 to 18 lb takes 3 hours 45 minutes to 4 hours 15 minutes. 19 to 20 lb takes 4 hours 15 minutes to 4 hours 30 minutes. 21 to 24 lb takes 4 hours 30 minutes to 5 hours. The chart aims, the thermometer decides: 165 F in the thickest part of the breast, the innermost thigh, and the innermost wing. For a 5 PM dinner on Thursday, November 26, 2026: 12 lb in the oven by 1:47 PM, 16 lb by 12:40 PM, 20 lb by 12:17 PM, 24 lb by 11:55 AM. Rest 20 minutes before carving.

## Can you thaw a turkey on the counter? (https://thawday.com/can-you-thaw-a-turkey-on-the-counter)

No. Never thaw a turkey on the counter. The outside warms up hours before the inside thaws. Bacteria grow in that warm layer. A turkey that sat out for more than 2 hours cannot be made safe, by cooking or by freezing. Throw it out. Safe ways: the fridge, about 24 hours for every 4 to 5 pounds at 40 F or below, or cold water at 30 minutes per pound.

## Can you thaw a turkey in the microwave? (https://thawday.com/can-you-thaw-a-turkey-in-the-microwave)

Yes. USDA's third safe way is the microwave: follow your oven manual for size and timing, and cook the turkey right after it thaws. ThawDay prints no microwave minutes, because the manual is the only honest source for them. Too big for the microwave: cold water at 30 minutes per pound, or the fridge at about 24 hours for every 4 to 5 pounds.

## How much turkey per person? (https://thawday.com/how-much-turkey-per-person)

Plan one pound of whole turkey per person. For leftovers, add half a pound per person. Bone and skin make up much of the weight. Bird sizes: 8 people buy 8 lb, or 12 lb with leftovers; 12 people buy 12 lb, or 18 lb; 16 people buy 16 lb, or 24 lb; 20 people buy 20 lb, or two birds of 15 lb each when leftovers push the need to 30 lb.

## When to buy a turkey for Thanksgiving (https://thawday.com/when-to-buy-a-turkey-for-thanksgiving)

Frozen: buy by Sunday, November 15, 2026, eleven days before dinner (kitchen practice: frozen birds sell out the weekend before Thanksgiving). Fresh: buy 1 to 2 days before cooking, so Tuesday, November 24 or Wednesday, November 25, 2026. Frozen thaw starts by weight: 12 lb on Monday, November 23; 16 lb on Sunday, November 22; 20 lb on Saturday, November 21; 24 lb on Friday, November 20.

## How long do turkey leftovers last? (https://thawday.com/how-long-do-turkey-leftovers-last)

Use refrigerated turkey, stuffing, and gravy within 3 to 4 days. For Thanksgiving 2026 that window ends Sunday, November 29 to Monday, November 30. Discard any turkey, stuffing, and gravy left out at room temperature longer than 2 hours; 1 hour in temperatures above 90 F. Divide leftovers into smaller portions. Refrigerate or freeze in covered shallow containers for quicker cooling. If freezing leftovers, use within 2 to 6 months for best quality.

## Should you stuff a turkey? (https://thawday.com/should-you-stuff-a-turkey)

For optimum safety, stuffing a turkey is not recommended. For more even cooking, it is recommended you cook your stuffing outside the bird in a casserole. The stuffing must reach a safe minimum internal temperature of 165 F. ThawDay plans turkeys with no stuffing; its roast times are the unstuffed 325 F bands.

## How long should a turkey rest before carving? (https://thawday.com/how-long-should-a-turkey-rest-before-carving)

For quality, let the turkey stand for 20 minutes before carving to allow juices to set. The turkey will carve more easily. For a 5:00 PM dinner on Thursday, November 26, 2026, the rest starts at 4:40 PM for every weight; oven-in times run from 1:47 PM for a 12 lb bird to 11:55 AM for a 24 lb bird.

## Should you wash a turkey before cooking? (https://thawday.com/should-you-wash-a-turkey-before-cooking)

No. Washing or rinsing any meat or poultry is not recommended, and actually increases the risk you will cross-contaminate germs to other foods you're preparing. Water can splash bacteria up to 3 feet surrounding your sink. The one exception is a brined bird: Thanksgiving cooks who are purchasing a brined turkey, or brining their turkeys at home, must rinse the brine off before the turkey goes into the oven.

## Can you trust the pop-up timer on a turkey? (https://thawday.com/can-you-trust-the-pop-up-timer-on-a-turkey)

Not on its own. If your turkey has a pop-up temperature indicator, it is recommended that you also check the internal temperature of the turkey in the innermost part of the thigh and wing and the thickest part of the breast with a food thermometer. The minimum internal temperature should reach 165 F for safety.

## How long can you keep a turkey in the freezer? (https://thawday.com/how-long-can-you-keep-a-turkey-in-the-freezer)

Keep frozen until you are ready to thaw it. Turkeys can be kept frozen in the freezer indefinitely; however, cook within 1 year for best quality. The 1 year line is about flavor and texture, not safety. Turkey parts keep up to 9 months and giblets 3 to 4 months for best quality.

## What if you cook a turkey with the giblets inside? (https://thawday.com/what-if-you-cook-a-turkey-with-the-giblets-inside)

It depends on the bag. If the giblets were wrapped in paper, there is no concern, as long as the turkey is fully cooked to 165 F, measured with a food thermometer. If giblets were packed in a plastic bag, and the bag has been altered or melted by the cooking process, do not use the giblets or the poultry because harmful chemicals may have leached into the surrounding meat.

## How to reheat leftover turkey? (https://thawday.com/how-to-reheat-leftover-turkey)

When reheating leftovers, be sure they reach 165 F as measured with a food thermometer. Cover leftovers to reheat; that retains moisture and ensures the food heats all the way through. Reheat sauces, soups and gravies by bringing them to a rolling boil. Frozen leftovers can reheat without thawing, in the oven or microwave. For Thanksgiving 2026, use refrigerated turkey, stuffing, and gravy within 3 to 4 days, by Sunday, November 29 to Monday, November 30.

## What temperature to cook a turkey? (https://thawday.com/what-temperature-to-cook-a-turkey)

Set the oven temperature no lower than 325 F and be sure the turkey is completely thawed. The USDA roasting chart is set at 325 F: up to 12 lb takes 2 hours 45 minutes to 3 hours, and 21 to 24 lb takes 4 hours 30 minutes to 5 hours. A meat thermometer decides when the bird is done: 165 F in the thickest part of the breast, the innermost thigh, and the innermost wing.

## When should I take the turkey out of the freezer for Christmas? (https://thawday.com/when-to-thaw-turkey-for-christmas)

Christmas dinner is Friday, December 25, 2026. Move a frozen turkey to the fridge by weight: up to 12 lb on Tuesday, December 22 (3 days); 13 to 16 lb on Monday, December 21 (4 days); 17 to 20 lb on Sunday, December 20 (5 days); 21 to 24 lb on Saturday, December 19 (6 days). Fridge thawing takes about 24 hours for every 4 to 5 pounds. A fresh bird: buy 1 to 2 days before cooking, on Wednesday, December 23 or Thursday, December 24.

## Can you thaw a turkey in cold water overnight? (https://thawday.com/can-you-thaw-a-turkey-in-cold-water-overnight)

No. Change the water every 30 minutes. Cook it right after it thaws. An overnight soak breaks both rules, because the water warms toward room temperature with no one changing it. Cold water takes 30 minutes per pound in daylight hours. The fridge is the overnight method: for Thanksgiving 2026, move a 12 lb bird on Monday, November 23 and a 24 lb bird on Friday, November 20.

## How long to thaw a turkey breast (https://thawday.com/how-long-to-thaw-a-turkey-breast)

ThawDay gives plain thaw times for holiday food. A 6 lb breast needs about 1.5 days in the fridge. Move it on Tuesday, November 24. Dinner is Thursday, November 26. In cold water, it needs 3 hours. Times by weight: 4 lb, about 1 day in the fridge, 2 hours in cold water; 6 lb, about 1.5 days, 3 hours; 8 lb, about 2 days, 4 hours. In the fridge: keep the fridge at 40 F or below. Leave the breast in its wrap, on a tray. USDA rate: 24 hours per 4 to 5 pounds. In cold water: seal the breast in a leak-proof bag. Sink it in cold tap water. Change the water each 30 minutes. Cook it right after it thaws. Never thaw a breast on the counter. The skin warms while the core stays frozen. Germs grow fast in that warm zone. Cook a thawed breast in 1 to 2 days.

## How long to thaw a ham (https://thawday.com/how-long-to-thaw-a-ham)

ThawDay gives plain thaw times for holiday food. A 10 lb ham needs about 2 days in the fridge. Move it on Tuesday, November 24. Dinner is Thursday, November 26. In cold water, it needs 5 hours. Times by weight: 5 lb, about 1 day in the fridge, 2.5 hours in cold water; 10 lb, about 2 days, 5 hours; 15 lb, about 3 days, 7.5 hours. In the fridge: keep the fridge at 40 F or below. Leave the ham in its wrap, on a tray. USDA rate: 4 to 5 hours per pound. In cold water: seal the ham in a leak-proof bag. Sink it in cold tap water. Change the water each 30 minutes. Cook it right after it thaws. Never thaw a ham on the counter. Never use hot water to speed it up. Warm spots grow germs while the core stays frozen. Cook a thawed ham in 3 to 5 days.

## Page: https://thawday.com/privacy

Privacy
Privacy
The short version: The calculator keeps your details in your browser. Ask sends your question to ThawDay's chat service, and nothing you type there is saved. Cloudflare and PostHog count visits to this site. There are no accounts or sign-ups.
What the calculator does
You pick the date, time, and turkey weight.
You say frozen or fresh, and brine or not.
The timeline math runs in your browser.
Nothing you type is sent to us.
It saves your plan on your device.
The plan stays in your browser.
It shows again when you return.
It also saves a small flag.
The flag says a plan was made.
What Ask does
Ask is the chat on this site.
It is on the home page, the calculator, and the Ask page.
You type a question in your own words.
Your question is sent to ThawDay's own chat service.
The service works out the answer and sends it back.
Nothing you type is saved.
Your follow-ups are held in the open page's memory only.
Closing the page ends the session.
If the chat service cannot be reached, the panel answers on the page itself.
Sharing your plan
The share button copies your plan text.
You choose where to paste it.
The turkey card is drawn in your browser.
Card sharing uses your device share sheet.
Nothing is shared unless you tap Share.
Site counts
This page also loads Cloudflare Web Analytics.
It sends page and performance counts to Cloudflare.
Cloudflare says its beacon uses no cookies.
Cloudflare says its beacon does not read local storage.
The home page and calculator run PostHog.
PostHog counts page views and tool starts.
It counts plan finishes, shares, and downloads.
Your typed answers are never sent to it.
Page addresses are cut to the page path before counting.
A shared plan link carries plan details in its address.
Those details are cut too, never counted.
It does not record your screen.
Our code reads the flag for return visits.
ThawDay inside an AI assistant
The promise above covers this website.
ThawDay also works inside AI assistants.
There, the assistant sends your answers to our connector.
It sends the date, time, weight, and choices.
The connector works out the timeline and sends it back.
It keeps nothing from the call.

## Page: https://thawday.com/thawing-a-brined-turkey

ThawDay
How to thaw a turkey you plan to brine
Brining does not change the thaw. A frozen turkey thaws on the same days whether you brine it or not. The bird must be fully thawed when brining starts, 24 hours before the oven.
Brine starts 24 hours before the oven Fully thawed before brining
Thaw times and move dates
The thaw is the same
Keep the fridge at 40 F or below, on a tray, in its wrapper.
Weight In the fridge Move it for Thanksgiving 2026 In cold water
12 lb 3 days Monday, November 23 6 hours
16 lb 4 days Sunday, November 22 8 hours
20 lb 5 days Saturday, November 21 10 hours
24 lb 6 days Friday, November 20 12 hours
When the brine starts
When the brine starts
For a 5 PM Thanksgiving dinner on Thursday, November 26, 2026:
Weight Start brining
12 lb Wednesday, November 25, 1:47 PM
16 lb Wednesday, November 25, 12:40 PM
20 lb Wednesday, November 25, 12:17 PM
24 lb Wednesday, November 25, 11:55 AM
Brine in the fridge the whole time, at 40 F or below. Never longer than two days. Discard the brine after. Start once the bird is thawed.
If the thaw runs late
If the thaw runs late
If it is still icy at brine time, use a shorter brine once it thaws, or skip the brine. A last-day cold-water rescue leaves no room for a full 24 hour brine.
Finishing a thaw in cold water: Seal the bird in a leak-proof plastic bag. Submerge it in cold tap water. Change the water every 30 minutes. Cook it right after it thaws. Full steps: thawing a turkey in cold water .
USDA's third safe way is the microwave: follow your microwave manual for size and timing, and cook the turkey right after it thaws. Never thaw a turkey on the counter. The outside warms up hours before the inside thaws. Bacteria grow in that warm layer.
Your exact dates, in seconds
Tell the calculator your weight and dinner time, and say yes to the brine. It stamps both dates. Or ask in your own words : "16 lb frozen turkey, brine it, dinner Thursday."

Turkey still frozen on Thanksgiving morning?
Dinner can still happen. You have two safe paths: thaw it in cold water, at 30 minutes per pound, or cook it from frozen. Never the counter, and never warm water.

Cold water 30 min per lb From frozen half again as long

Path 1: cold water, if the hours fit

16 lb 8 hours Thu, Nov 26, 4:40 AM
20 lb 10 hours Thu, Nov 26, 2:17 AM
24 lb 12 hours Wed, Nov 25, 11:55 PM
Seal the bird in a leak-proof plastic bag. Submerge it in cold tap water. Change the water every 30 minutes. Cook it right after it thaws. Full steps: thawing a turkey in cold water .
Partly thawed? These hours are for a rock-frozen bird, so yours finishes sooner. At breakfast with a 20 lb bird, cold water cannot finish. Use Path 2.
Path 2: cook it from frozen
Path 2: cook it from frozen

## Page: https://thawday.com/can-you-refreeze-a-thawed-turkey

ThawDay
Can you refreeze a thawed turkey?
Yes, if it thawed in the fridge. USDA says a fridge-thawed turkey can be refrozen without cooking first. Do it within 1 to 2 days, the same window you had to cook it. Details: how long a thawed turkey keeps .
Fridge-thawed refreeze raw within 1–2 days Cold-water thawed cook it first
The rule depends on the thaw
The rule depends on the thaw
Fridge thaw: refreeze it raw, within 1 to 2 days of the full thaw. Keep it at 40 F or below the whole time, on a tray, in its wrapper.
Cold water or microwave thaw: cook it first. Those methods end with "cook right after it thaws," and that rule still holds. Freeze the cooked turkey instead. Cooked turkey keeps 3 to 4 days in the fridge.
Left on the counter: never. A turkey that sat out for more than 2 hours cannot be made safe, by cooking or by freezing. Throw it out.
The honest tradeoff
The honest tradeoff
Refreezing is safe, but quality drops. Thawing drains moisture, so the bird roasts drier the second time. It works better for soup, stock, and sandwiches than as the holiday centerpiece.
When you thaw it again
When you thaw it again
Thaw it in the fridge, on the normal days for its weight , and cook it within 1 to 2 days. Or thaw it in cold water: Seal the bird in a leak-proof plastic bag. Submerge it in cold tap water. Change the water every 30 minutes. Cook it right after it thaws. Or run the dates through the calculator .
USDA's third safe way is the microwave: follow your microwave manual for size and timing, and cook the turkey right after it thaws. Never thaw a turkey on the counter. The outside warms up hours before the inside thaws. Bacteria grow in that warm layer.
New plan? New dates
Tell the calculator the new dinner and the weight. Get fresh buy, thaw, brine, and roast dates. Or ask in your own words : "14 lb frozen turkey, dinner Saturday."

## Page: https://thawday.com/can-you-thaw-a-turkey-in-the-sink

ThawDay
Can you thaw a turkey in the sink?
Not the way most people mean it. A turkey sitting in a sink of warm or standing water is not safe. The sink is fine as a tub for cold water thawing, done by the rules below.
Water cold only Change it every 30 min
What goes wrong
What goes wrong
Standing water warms to room temperature. The outside sits warm for hours while the inside stays frozen, and bacteria grow in that warm layer. Warm or hot water makes it worse.
The safe sink method
The safe sink method
The sink is just the tub for the USDA cold water method: 30 minutes per pound. Seal the bird in a leak-proof plastic bag. Submerge it in cold tap water. Change the water every 30 minutes. Cook it right after it thaws. Cover the bird fully; each change keeps it cold while it thaws.
Weight Cold water time
12 lb 6 hours
16 lb 8 hours
20 lb 10 hours
24 lb 12 hours
Full steps: thawing a turkey in cold water . When it is done, wash the sink and anything the raw turkey touched with hot, soapy water.
The hands-off way: the fridge
The hands off way
No time to change water every 30 minutes? Use the fridge: days, but no watching. Dates by weight: how long to thaw a turkey .
USDA's third safe way is the microwave: follow your microwave manual for size and timing, and cook the turkey right after it thaws. Never thaw a turkey on the counter. The outside warms up hours before the inside thaws. Bacteria grow in that warm layer.
Your exact date, in seconds
Use the calculator for your buy, thaw, brine, and roast dates. Or ask in your own words : "14 lb frozen turkey, dinner Thursday."

Turkey thawing chart
In the fridge: about 24 hours for every 4 to 5 pounds. Keep the fridge at 40 F or below. A 14 lb turkey needs 4 days. A 20 lb turkey needs 5 days. In cold water: 30 minutes per pound.

Weight Fridge Cold water
4–12 lb 1–3 days 2–6 hrs
12–16 lb 3–4 days 6–8 hrs
16–20 lb 4–5 days 8–10 hrs
20–24 lb 5–6 days 10–12 hrs

How the safe ways work
Source: USDA Food Safety and Inspection Service.
The safe ways
The fridge is hands-off. Put the turkey on a tray, breast up. Leave it in its wrapper. Give it the full time in the table.
Cold water is faster. Seal the bird in a leak-proof plastic bag. Submerge it in cold tap water. Change the water every 30 minutes. Cook it right after it thaws. Full steps: thawing a turkey in cold water .
Fridge 24 hours per 4–5 lb Hands-off
Cold water 30 min per lb Fastest
Microwave Per your microwave manual No waiting
USDA's third safe way is the microwave: follow your microwave manual for size and timing, and cook the turkey right after it thaws. Never thaw a turkey on the counter. The outside warms up hours before the inside thaws. Bacteria grow in that warm layer.
After the thaw
Cooking on Thanksgiving, Thursday, November 26? See the exact fridge move dates , by weight.
Once the turkey is thawed, it keeps 1 to 2 days in the fridge before you cook it.

ThawDay
How long to brine a turkey
24 hours. Start the brine 24 hours before the turkey goes in the oven. Never longer than two days. Worked example: a 16 lb turkey for a 5 PM Thanksgiving dinner on Thursday, November 26, 2026 starts brining on Wednesday, November 25, at 12:40 PM .
Copy this plan
Brine 24 hours Start Wed, Nov 25 Never longer than 2 days Fully thawed before brining
When the brine starts
When the brine starts
For a 5 PM Thanksgiving dinner on Thursday, November 26, 2026:
Weight Start brining
12 lb Wednesday, November 25, 1:47 PM
16 lb Wednesday, November 25, 12:40 PM
20 lb Wednesday, November 25, 12:17 PM
24 lb Wednesday, November 25, 11:55 AM
Brine in the fridge the whole time, at 40 F or below. Never longer than two days. Discard the brine after. Start once the bird is thawed.

Thaw a turkey fast

## Page: https://thawday.com/turkey-thaw-time-per-pound

ThawDay
ThawDay gives plain thaw times for holiday food.
Turkey thaw time per pound
Fridge: 1 day per 4 to 5 lb. Cold water: 30 minutes per pound. Buy a 14 lb bird on Friday, November 20. Put it in the fridge by Sunday, November 22 .
Get my full turkey plan
The math, by weight
Turkey weight In the fridge In cold water
8 lb 3 days 4 hours
12 lb 3 days 6 hours
16 lb 4 days 8 hours
20 lb 5 days 10 hours
24 lb 6 days 12 hours
The fridge rule
USDA rate: 24 hours per 4 to 5 pounds. Keep the fridge at 40 F or below. Leave the bird in its wrap, on a tray.
The water rule
USDA rate: 30 minutes per pound. Seal the bird in a leak-proof bag. Change the water each 30 minutes. Cook it right after it thaws.
Never thaw a turkey on the counter. The skin warms while the core stays frozen. Germs grow fast in that warm zone. Cook a thawed bird in 1 to 2 days.
Your bird, your date
The calculator turns your weight into buy, thaw, and roast dates. Or ask in your own words .

## Page: https://thawday.com/when-to-buy-a-turkey-for-christmas

ThawDay
When to buy a turkey for Christmas
Frozen: buy by Monday, December 14, 2026. Fresh: buy 1 to 2 days before cooking, so Wednesday, December 23 or Thursday, December 24 . Dinner is Friday, December 25, 2026.
Frozen buy by Mon, Dec 14 Fresh buy Dec 23–24
Frozen birds: when to buy
Frozen birds: the buy date is about the store
The calculator stamps this date eleven days before dinner and labels it kitchen practice, not a USDA date. Frozen birds sell out the weekend before Christmas; the hard dates come from the thaw.
Then the thaw starts, by weight
Then the thaw starts, by weight
A frozen bird bought by December 14 waits in your freezer until its fridge day:
Weight Move to the fridge
12 lb Tuesday, December 22
16 lb Monday, December 21
20 lb Sunday, December 20
24 lb Saturday, December 19
Full dates for every weight are on when to take the turkey out of the freezer . Not sure what weight to buy? Start with how much turkey per person : one pound each.
Fresh birds: the short window
Fresh birds: the short window
Fresh: buy 1 to 2 days before cooking. A fresh bird goes from the store to your fridge, at 40 F or below, and into the oven on Friday.
Late either way? A frozen bird can still thaw in cold water: Seal the bird in a leak-proof plastic bag. Submerge it in cold tap water. Change the water every 30 minutes. Cook it right after it thaws.
USDA's third safe way is the microwave: follow your microwave manual for size and timing, and cook the turkey right after it thaws. Never thaw a turkey on the counter. The outside warms up hours before the inside thaws. Bacteria grow in that warm layer.
Your exact dates, in seconds
Tell the calculator your weight and dinner time for the full plan. Or ask in your own words : "16 lb turkey, dinner Friday at 5."

## Page: https://thawday.com/turkey-still-frozen-on-christmas-morning

ThawDay
Turkey still frozen on Christmas morning?
Dinner can still happen. You have two safe paths: thaw it in cold water, at 30 minutes per pound, or cook it from frozen. Never the counter, and never warm water.
Cold water 30 min per lb From frozen half again as long
Path 1: cold water, if the hours fit
Path 1: cold water, if the hours fit
Cold water takes 30 minutes per pound, and the bird must be thawed by oven time. For a 5 PM dinner today, Friday, December 25, 2026, start by:
Weight Cold water time Start by
12 lb 6 hours Fri, Dec 25, 7:47 AM
16 lb 8 hours Fri, Dec 25, 4:40 AM
20 lb 10 hours Fri, Dec 25, 2:17 AM
24 lb 12 hours Thu, Dec 24, 11:55 PM
Seal the bird in a leak-proof plastic bag. Submerge it in cold tap water. Change the water every 30 minutes. Cook it right after it thaws. Full steps: thawing a turkey in cold water .
Partly thawed? These hours are for a rock-frozen bird, so yours finishes sooner. At breakfast with a 20 lb bird, cold water cannot finish. Use Path 2.
Path 2: cook it from frozen
Path 2: cook it from frozen
Roast at 325 F. A frozen bird takes at least half again as long as a thawed one.
Weight Time from frozen, at 325 F
12 lb 4 hours 15 minutes to 4 hours 30 minutes
16 lb 5 hours 45 minutes to 6 hours 30 minutes
20 lb 6 hours 30 minutes to 6 hours 45 minutes
24 lb 6 hours 45 minutes to 7 hours 30 minutes
No oven bag. Pull the giblet packet out with tongs once the outside softens. The thermometer decides: 165 F. Full steps: cooking a turkey from frozen .
USDA's third safe way is the microwave: follow your microwave manual for size and timing, and cook the turkey right after it thaws. Never thaw a turkey on the counter. The outside warms up hours before the inside thaws. Bacteria grow in that warm layer.
Your exact times, in seconds
The calculator stamps your oven time for either path. Or ask in your own words : "Frozen 16 lb turkey, dinner at 5 today."

## Page: https://thawday.com/when-to-thaw-turkey-for-christmas-eve

ThawDay
When should I take the turkey out of the freezer for Christmas Eve?
Christmas Eve dinner is Thursday, December 24, 2026. Find your weight. That is your move date.
The move dates, by weight
Up to 12 lb · Mon, Dec 21 Thu 24
3 days
Add to calendar (.ics) Google Calendar
13–16 lb · Sun, Dec 20 Thu 24
4 days
Add to calendar (.ics) Google Calendar
17–20 lb · Sat, Dec 19 Thu 24
5 days
Add to calendar (.ics) Google Calendar
21–24 lb · Fri, Dec 18 Thu 24
6 days
Add to calendar (.ics) Google Calendar
Fridge rule 24 hours per 4–5 lb Dinner Thu, Dec 24
Cooking on Christmas Day instead? Every date moves one day later: when to take the turkey out of the freezer for Christmas .
Why this date
Exactly: 12 lb Monday, December 21. 14 lb and 16 lb Sunday, December 20. 18 lb and 20 lb Saturday, December 19. 22 lb and 24 lb Friday, December 18.
Why these dates
Fridge thawing takes about 24 hours for every 4 to 5 pounds. Keep the fridge at 40 F or below. Count back from Thursday and you land on the dates above. Start early: a thawed turkey keeps 1 to 2 days in the fridge. Start late, and a half-frozen bird roasts unevenly.
A fresh bird instead
A fresh bird instead
Fresh: buy 1 to 2 days before cooking, on Tuesday, December 22 or Wednesday, December 23. Keep it in the fridge at 40 F or below, and cook it on Thursday.
If your plans change
Already past your date?
Use cold water today. Seal the bird in a leak-proof plastic bag. Submerge it in cold tap water. It takes about 30 minutes per pound. Change the water every 30 minutes. Cook it right after it thaws. Full steps: thawing a turkey in cold water . No time? Cook it from frozen . USDA says it is safe, and it takes at least half again as long.
USDA's third safe way is the microwave: follow your microwave manual for size and timing, and cook the turkey right after it thaws. Never thaw a turkey on the counter. The outside warms up hours before the inside thaws. Bacteria grow in that warm layer.
Your exact dates, in seconds
Tell the calculator your weight and dinner time for the full plan. Or ask in your own words : "16 lb turkey, dinner Thursday at 5."
More questions
Quick answers
When should I thaw a turkey for Christmas Eve?
For Christmas Eve dinner on Thursday, December 24, 2026: up to 12 lb moves to the fridge on Monday, December 21; 13 to 16 lb on Sunday, December 20; 17 to 20 lb on Saturday, December 19; 21 to 24 lb on Friday, December 18.
How long does a turkey take to thaw in the fridge?
Fridge thawing takes about 24 hours for every 4 to 5 pounds. A 16 lb bird takes 4 days.
What if I miss the fridge date?
Seal the bird in a leak-proof plastic bag. Submerge it in cold tap water. Change the water every 30 minutes. Cook it right after it thaws.

When should I take the turkey out of the freezer for Friendsgiving?
Friendsgiving dinner is Saturday, November 21, 2026 . Find your weight. That is your move date.
Up to 12 lb · Wed, Nov 18 Sat 21
3 days

Fridge rule 24 hours per 4–5 lb Thawed keeps 1–2 days
Friendsgiving after Thanksgiving instead, on Saturday, November 28 ? Move dates: up to 12 lb on Wednesday, November 25; 13 to 16 lb on Tuesday, November 24; 17 to 20 lb on Monday, November 23; 21 to 24 lb on Sunday, November 22.
Cooking on Thanksgiving Day, Thursday, November 26, instead? Use the Thanksgiving move dates .
Why this date
Common sizes: 12 lb on Wednesday, November 18; 14 lb and 16 lb on Tuesday, November 17; 18 lb and 20 lb on Monday, November 16; 22 lb and 24 lb on Sunday, November 15. These dates are for a 5 PM Friendsgiving dinner.
Why these dates
Fridge thawing takes about 24 hours for every 4 to 5 pounds. Keep the fridge at 40 F or below. Count back from Saturday and you land on the dates above.
Start early: a thawed turkey keeps 1 to 2 days in the fridge. Start late, and a half-frozen bird roasts unevenly.
If your plans change
Already past your date?
Use cold water today. Seal the turkey in a leak-proof plastic bag and submerge it in cold tap water. It takes about 30 minutes per pound. Change the water every 30 minutes, and cook the turkey right after it thaws. Full steps: thawing a turkey in cold water .
No time? Cook it from frozen . USDA says it is safe, and it takes at least half again as long.
Never thaw a turkey on the counter. Use the fridge or cold water. Microwave thawing is USDA-safe too: follow your microwave manual, and cook the turkey right after it thaws.

When should I take the turkey out of the freezer for Thanksgiving Eve?
Thanksgiving Eve dinner is Wednesday, November 25, 2026 . Find your weight. That is your move date.

Fridge rule 24 hours per 4–5 lb Thawed keeps 1–2 days
Cooking on Thanksgiving Day instead? Every date moves one day later: when to take the turkey out of the freezer for Thanksgiving .
Why this date
Common sizes: 12 lb on Sunday, November 22; 14 lb and 16 lb on Saturday, November 21; 18 lb and 20 lb on Friday, November 20; 22 lb and 24 lb on Thursday, November 19. These dates are for a 5 PM Thanksgiving Eve dinner.
Why these dates
Fridge thawing takes about 24 hours for every 4 to 5 pounds. Keep the fridge at 40 F or below. Count back from Wednesday and you land on the dates above.
Start early: a thawed turkey keeps 1 to 2 days in the fridge. Start late, and a half-frozen bird roasts unevenly.
If your plans change
Already past your date?
Use cold water today. Seal the turkey in a leak-proof plastic bag and submerge it in cold tap water. It takes about 30 minutes per pound. Change the water every 30 minutes, and cook the turkey right after it thaws. Full steps: thawing a turkey in cold water .
No time? Cook it from frozen . USDA says it is safe, and it takes at least half again as long.
Never thaw a turkey on the counter. Use the fridge or cold water. Microwave thawing is USDA-safe too: follow your microwave manual, and cook the turkey right after it thaws.
Your full plan, not just the thaw
The calculator adds the buy date, the brine start, and the oven time. It makes a calendar file for your phone. Or ask in your own words and get the whole plan on one page.

## How long to thaw a Butterball turkey (https://thawday.com/how-long-to-thaw-a-butterball-turkey)

The same as any turkey: about 24 hours for every 4 to 5 pounds in the fridge. USDA thaw times go by weight, not by brand, so a Butterball follows the same chart. A 14 lb Butterball needs 4 days; for a 5 PM Thanksgiving dinner on Thursday, November 26, 2026, move it on Sunday, November 22. By weight band: up to 12 lb, move Monday, November 23; 13 to 16 lb, Sunday, November 22; 17 to 20 lb, Saturday, November 21; 21 to 24 lb, Friday, November 20. In cold water: 30 minutes per pound. Never thaw a turkey on the counter.

## How long to thaw a spatchcock turkey (https://thawday.com/how-long-to-thaw-a-spatchcock-turkey)

Thaw it whole, before flattening it: the same times as any turkey, about 24 hours for every 4 to 5 pounds in the fridge (a 14 lb bird needs 4 days; move it Sunday, November 22 for Thanksgiving 2026), or 30 minutes per pound in cold water. Spatchcocking (removing the backbone and pressing the bird flat) happens after the thaw. Roasted flat at 325 F, it finishes sooner than a whole bird; the USDA chart has no separate spatchcock line, so the whole-bird times are the ceiling and a thermometer decides: 165 F in the thickest part of the breast, the innermost thigh, and the innermost wing.

## Can you thaw a turkey in an air fryer? (https://thawday.com/can-you-thaw-a-turkey-in-an-air-fryer)

No. An air fryer cooks; it does not thaw, and a whole turkey does not fit in one. USDA's safe thaw methods are the fridge, cold water, and the microwave. The fastest safe way is cold water: 30 minutes per pound (8 lb: 4 hours; 12 lb: 6 hours; 14 lb: 7 hours; 16 lb: 8 hours; 20 lb: 10 hours; 24 lb: 12 hours), water changed every 30 minutes, cook right after it thaws. A turkey breast fits in many air fryers once thawed; thaw it first, the same ways.
